info.title: ABIS API
info.description: Read-first REST seam over the legacy ABIS database (modernization Phase 2).

get.summary: Rejected (3) / rebanded (7) coils for a job's invoice, each with its exact billed weight.
Computed invoice for a job (weight buckets + spec) with exact rejected-coil billing.
Saved invoice records for a job.

post.summary: Save an invoice record (number + date + notes) for a job.

get.summary: Get one saved invoice by job + invoice number.
List the admin scheduled-job definitions. INERT — no execution engine runs them in this phase.

post.summary: Define a scheduled job (imported or native). Storing it does NOT schedule or run anything — there is no execution engine in this phase.
Set a job's enabled flag on. NOTE: the flag is stored only — it does not cause execution in this phase.

get.summary: A job's run history (populated by the scheduler engine).

post.summary: Run a scheduled job now (records a run). Only allowlisted operations execute — an unknown/legacy operation is recorded 'unsupported' and never fires. 404 if the job is unknown.

get.summary: The operations the scheduler is allowed to run — the valid values for a job's target_operation. Anything else is recorded 'unsupported' and never executes.

post.summary: Define an EDI transaction type + version (config only — transmits nothing).

put.summary: Update an EDI type's description.

post.summary: Define a trading-partner EDI route (config only). Validates the customer + referenced EDI type exist.

delete.summary: Remove a trading-partner EDI route.

put.summary: Set a customer's 'create 861 at receiving' flag (Y/N). Config only — generates no EDI.
Create or update a customer's EDI trading-partner profile for a document (861/870/846/856/863). Config only — sets how the document is framed; generates/sends nothing.

delete.summary: Remove a customer's EDI trading-partner profile for a document.

post.summary: Send a test email — verifies SMTP + the global test-recipient override (all mail → Email:OverrideRecipient).

get.summary: Server console: status of the allowlisted systemd units (abis, nginx). Read-only.
Server console: tail an allowlisted unit's journal (read-only). ?tail=N (clamped).

post.summary: Server console: restart an allowlisted unit (mutating — needs AllowRestart + the sudoers allowlist). 409 if not permitted / failed.

get.summary: Server console: read-only view of the DB-host crontab (via a command-locked channel). 503 until configured.
List the action/audit log, newest first.

post.summary: Piece-weight calculator: blank area (by shape) × gauge × alloy density (from METAL_DENSITY, or an explicit density). Optionally returns pieces per skid for a max skid weight.

get.summary: List carriers / trucking partners (paged, sortable; filter by status).

post.summary: Create a carrier (server-assigned id; requires carrierFullName).

get.summary: Get one carrier by id.

put.summary: Replace a carrier. Supports If-Match.

get.summary: Coils on a job to evaluate (coil ⋈ process_coil).
Dimensional QC checks recorded on a sheet skid.

post.summary: Record a dimensional QC check on a sheet-skid piece. When WinSPC is configured and has data for the skid's job, in_spec is set from WinSPC's authoritative spec limits (LSL/USL) and the note records the verdict; otherwise the supplied in_spec is used. PC# auto-increments when omitted.

put.summary: Edit a dimensional QC check (re-applies the WinSPC gate); 404 if the check isn't on the skid.

delete.summary: Delete a dimensional QC check from a sheet skid; 404 if it isn't there.

get.summary: Dimensional-QC board for a job: each skid's in-spec/out-of-spec/unchecked status + good vs out-of-spec piece/weight roll-ups, plus WinSPC's own verdict when configured.
Scrap items found during evaluation for a job (joined to the scrap-type catalog).

post.summary: Record (upsert) a scrap item found during coil evaluation.

get.summary: The coil-ownership transfer ledger (optionally scoped to a customer).

post.summary: Record a coil-ownership transfer: issues a certificate, MINTS a new coil for the new owner (status New, carrying the original's attributes) and marks the original coil Transferred — it does not mutate ownership in place. The new coil_abc_num is server-assigned. 409 if the new owner already owns the coil.

get.summary: The printable transfer certificate (full customer addresses + coil details).
Coils eligible to transfer, with their current owner (the coil picker).
List raw input coils (paged, filterable, sortable). search matches org/mill coil #, lot, mid-number, or notes; temper filters by coil temper.

post.summary: Create a coil on receipt (rejects a duplicate org+customer+MID).

get.summary: Coil inventory weight rollup grouped by alloy or location.
Get one coil by id.

patch.summary: Update a coil's status, location, or notes (409 if the coil is done/shipped/transferred). Supports If-Match.

delete.summary: Delete a coil, guarded: 409 if it's been applied to a job or is done/shipped/transferred; 404 if unknown; 204 on delete.

get.summary: List a coil's processing history (the jobs that consumed it).

post.summary: Bulk-mark coils Ready for transfer (status 12) — the precondition for the ownership-transfer picker. Terminal (done/shipped/transferred), already-ready, zero-balance, and unknown coils are skipped with a reason.

get.summary: A coil's quality capture: the header (material grade / dimensions / mill / PCC) + its flaw map.

put.summary: Create or replace a coil's quality header (coilOrgNum required); 404 if the coil is unknown.

post.summary: Add a flaw segment (start→end position + single-char flaw code) to a coil's flaw map; 404 if the coil is unknown.

delete.summary: Delete a flaw segment by its key (startingPosition, endingPosition, flawCode query params); 404 if not found.

post.summary: Record a coil's ACTUAL weighed weight (abco_coil_net_wt); rejects values outside the legacy 100..99999 lb guard.

get.summary: List customers (paged, sortable).

post.summary: Create a customer.

get.summary: Get one customer by id.

put.summary: Replace a customer. Supports If-Match.

delete.summary: Delete a customer (and its contacts + recovery config). 409 if the customer is referenced by any order, part, coil, or shipment.

get.summary: List the contacts for a customer.

post.summary: Add a contact to a customer (server-assigned id; requires lastName).

get.summary: Get one customer contact by id.

put.summary: Replace a customer contact (owning customer unchanged). Supports If-Match.

get.summary: The live line board (line_current_status): each line's current shift, job, coil and skid positions.
One line's live board row; 404 when the line has no line_current_status row.
A line's job queue (line_priority): running job first, then by priority. Ended jobs are hidden unless includeEnded=true.

put.summary: Add or edit one job in a line's queue (omitted fields keep their value; a new row lands at the end, status Waiting).

delete.summary: Remove a job from a line's queue; refuses (409) the job the line is currently running.

post.summary: Re-sequence a line's queue: the listed jobs take priority 1..N; jobs left out follow in their existing order.
Point a line at the job it is running (null clears it); re-sequences the line's LINE_PRIORITY queue.
Load the coil on the mandrel (null drops it); loading marks the coil as on-line and zeroes the process rate.
Bind an already-scheduled shift to the line's board (the DAS station starting its shift).
Close the line's open shift: stamps end_time + the shift's downtime total (seconds) and clears the board's shift.

get.summary: The coil runs recorded in a shift (shift_coil), in run order — the shift's production ledger.
Resolve a scanned coil barcode against a job's coils: strips the 2S vendor header, validates, and returns the coil (or why it didn't resolve).

post.summary: Create the shift rows for a date from the SHIFT_SCHEDULE calendar (idempotent; defaults to today). Returns the shifts created — empty when none are scheduled or they already exist.

get.summary: Shifts with no end_time, longest-open first. staleOnly=true keeps those open >1 day; boardOnly=true keeps only shifts a line's board still points at (the actionable ones — prod has ~247 open, only ~3 on a board).
End-coil recap: the run plus the skids, pieces, finished weight, scrap and yield that came off that coil on that job.

post.summary: Start running a coil on a line: opens its shift_coil run and puts the coil on the board (idempotent per shift/job/coil).
Finish the coil the line is running: stamps the run's end weight/status + process_wt, rolls the weight through process_coil + the coil, and finishes the job when every coil on it is spent.

get.summary: A line's live metrics: shift efficiency % (legacy downtime formula), processed weight, and the loaded coil's finish-% and yield % (legacy 95% target).

post.summary: Change the job the line is running WITHOUT dropping the coil: splits the coil's weight between the two jobs' runs.
Reverse a wrongly-loaded coil: drops it off the board, deletes its unproduced run and logs an error_evt. 409 once the run has processed weight.

get.summary: List dies/tooling (paged, sortable; filter by status).

post.summary: Create a die/tooling record (server-assigned id; requires dieName).

get.summary: Get one die by id.

put.summary: Replace a die/tooling record. Supports If-Match.

get.summary: Die → shape mappings (which line/die makes which shape), optionally filtered by sheetType (the scheduling lookup), lineNum, or dieId. Enriched with die name + line description.

post.summary: Map a shape to a (line, die). 404 if the line or die doesn't exist; 409 'duplicate' if the mapping already exists.

delete.summary: Remove a die → shape mapping.

get.summary: Printable packing ticket for ONE unit on a packing list (legacy rpabco/d_packaging_ticket_{sheet,scrap,rejcoil}_4skid) — the paper stapled to a single skid. itemType is SHEET, SCRAP or REJECT_COIL; refNum is the skid number, or the coil's ABC number for a rejected coil. Sheet tickets carry the blank's shape dimensions.
Printable sheet-skid tag (HTML with a Code 39 barcode).
Printable scrap-skid tag (HTML with a Code 39 barcode).
Printable die/tool report (all dies, optionally filtered by status).
Printable coil ABC label (HTML with a Code 39 barcode) — the coil-receiving scanner tag.
Printable coil-ownership transfer certificate (toll-processing document) as HTML.
Printable invoice for a job (weight rollups + spec block). Optional invoiceNum stamps the saved number/date.
Printable packing list / ticket for a shipment — the header + every line item it carries (sheet / scrap / reject-coil) with weight + piece totals.
Printable combi form (packing list + weight certificate, weights in lb and kg).

Printable bill of lading (legacy rpabco/u_default_billoflading) — ship-from / ship-to / carrier, the per-job PO/part blocks, the three freight sections (sheet skids / accumulated scrap return / rejected coil return) with counts and weights, the multi-stop package note, and signature lines. 409 when the shipment carries nothing, since a blank BOL is worse than none.
List downtime instances, newest first (paged, sortable; filter by abJobNum/shiftNum).

post.summary: Log a downtime instance.

get.summary: Get one downtime instance by id.

put.summary: Replace a downtime instance. Supports If-Match.

get.summary: The cause-segments (reason + duration) logged against a downtime instance.

post.summary: Add a cause-segment (reason + duration) to a downtime instance.

get.summary: List outbound EDI transactions, newest first (paged, sortable; filter by customerId/transactionTypeId).
Get one outbound EDI transaction by its EDI file id.
The stored X12 payload for a generated EDI transaction, as plain text. Generation only — nothing here transmits.

post.summary: Generate + persist the 870 (Order/Coil Status) batch for a customer (default Aleris 1980) — every not-yet-reported shippable item + finished-job scrap, built and stored but NEVER transmitted. Returns status 'nothing' when there's nothing to report; view the payload at /edi/transactions/{ediFileId}/payload. Marks reported items/jobs so they aren't sent twice.

Generate + persist the 856 (Advance Ship Notice) for a shipment's packing list — the shipment header + one item per packed skid, built and stored but NEVER transmitted. 404 if the packing list has no shipment; 422 if its customer isn't an 856 partner; 409 if already generated. View the payload at /edi/transactions/{ediFileId}/payload.

Generate + persist the 846 (Inventory Advice) for a customer (default Cleveland-Cliffs 3061) — a full on-hand inventory snapshot (skids + coils), built and stored but NEVER transmitted. Returns status 'nothing' when there's no on-hand inventory; view the payload at /edi/transactions/{ediFileId}/payload. 422 if the customer isn't a configured 846 partner. The 846 is a snapshot — it may be regenerated (no dedup guard).

get.summary: The per-(customer, transaction set) EDI trading-partner profiles — the config backbone that lets each customer have different requirements for their 861/870/846/… documents. Optionally filter by transactionSet.
List EDI transmission-log entries, newest first (paged, sortable; filter by customerId).

Outbound transactions still awaiting a 997 functional acknowledgment (fa_received_time IS NULL), oldest first — the in-app form of the legacy check_997.sh email. Each is bucketed by age: fresh (<2h), waiting (2–24h, what legacy chased), overdue (>24h). Read-only.

post.summary: Ingest an inbound 997 (Functional Acknowledgment) and reconcile its acks against the outbound ledger — stamps fa_received_time / fa_receive_status on each matched transaction (matched by group control number = edi_file_id). Parse + store only; never transmits. Returns a matched/unmatched + accept/reject summary.

get.summary: List production jobs (paged; filter by status, completed=Done vs active, or search job/order #).

post.summary: Create a production job (requires the order refs it belongs to).

get.summary: Get one production job by id.

patch.summary: Update a job's status, notes, men, or finish time (409 if the job is done). Supports If-Match.

get.summary: List the coils a job has processed.
List the finished sheet skids produced by a job.
List the scrap skids generated by a job.
List a job's in-process partial skids.
List shop-floor scan events for a job.
What each PLC fault code means, for a line (plus the line-0 wildcards that apply to every line). Empty until the plant records its codes.

put.summary: Record what a PLC fault code means (line 0 = applies to every line).

delete.summary: Remove a PLC fault-code entry.

get.summary: Equipment systems (level 2 of the maintenance hierarchy), optionally scoped to a group/department.
Equipment subsystems (level 3), optionally scoped to one system.
Items/devices (level 4 — the finest grain a PM can target), optionally scoped to one subsystem.
Maintenance crafts/trades and their hourly rates.
The PM shift codes a PM can be assigned to.
Maintenance frequency codes (the catalog pm.maint_freq is a foreign key to), shortest interval first. freqType CAL = calendar (daysBetween drives the schedule) | HMC = hours/miles/cycles.
List distinct alloys (reference data for dropdowns).
Blank shape catalog: each shape's dimension schema (names + which carry a tolerance) and die count — drives a dynamic per-shape form.
List production lines (referenced by jobs, coils, downtime).
List maintenance groups/departments (referenced by maintenance logs).
List downtime causes/reasons (master data for the downtime feature).
List transportation method codes (referenced by shipments).
List shipping equipment type codes (referenced by shipments).
List customer classifications (referenced by customers).
List EDI transaction-set types and X12 versions (table edi_type).
List customer EDI trading-partner configuration (table customer_edi).
List maintenance log entries, newest first (paged, sortable; filter by status/groupDepartmentId).

post.summary: Create a maintenance log entry (requires probDateTime, probDetails, author).

get.summary: Get one maintenance log entry by id.

put.summary: Replace a maintenance log entry. Supports If-Match.

get.summary: List preventive-maintenance definitions (paged, sortable; filter by groupDepartmentId / pmStatus / sysEquipmentId). Each row carries its equipment-hierarchy names plus the derived daysUntilDue + dueBucket (overdue|due|scheduled|undated).

post.summary: Create a preventive-maintenance definition. Equipment/craft ids are checked up front so a bad reference is a 400, not a FK 500.

get.summary: The PM due board: active PMs that are overdue or fall due within withinDays (default 7), most overdue first. A PM counts as inactive only when pm_status = 0; undated PMs never appear.
One PM definition with its equipment-hierarchy names and derived due state.

put.summary: Update a PM definition (full replace). Stamps lastupdate.

delete.summary: Delete a PM and its checklist. 409 when completions reference it (retire with pm_status = 0 instead); 404 if unknown; 204 on delete.

get.summary: A PM's checklist items (pm_actions), in order.

post.summary: Add a checklist item to a PM. 404 if the PM is unknown.

get.summary: A PM's completion history (pmcompletions), newest first.

post.summary: Record a PM completion: writes the pmcompletions history row, stamps pm_completed/completed_by, resets the overdue counter, and ADVANCES nextduedate from the PM's interval (daysBetween, else 365/numOfTimesPerYear) off the completion date. Pass nextDueDate to set it explicitly; a PM with no interval keeps its stored date. The response reports which basis was used.

delete.summary: Remove a checklist item from a PM (scoped by PM, so an item from another PM can't be deleted here).

get.summary: Service info, version, and links.
Liveness probe — the process is up.
Readiness probe — verifies database connectivity (503 when unreachable).
Report-not-triggered check — whether outbound EDI looks stalled during business hours (config-gated).
Browser OIDC client config (or { oidc:false } to use the API-key field).

post.summary: Sign in with an ABIS user login + password (verified against Active Directory when Auth:Ldap is enabled, else the local credential store); returns a bearer token that drives RBAC.
Change the signed-in user's own ABIS password (sets it if none exists yet).

get.summary: OPC log sessions.
Captured OPC readings (host/device/item/value/quality) for a log.
The distinct OPC item names seen — the real tag catalog (informs Edge:Opc:Tags).
List order line items (paged, sortable).
Get one order line item by its composite key (order + line number).

put.summary: Replace an order line item (by order + line number). Supports If-Match.

post.summary: Add a line item to an order (line number assigned per order).

get.summary: List the line items for an order.
Get an order line's blank geometry — the shape's dimensions (value + tolerances) and dies.

put.summary: Set an order line's blank geometry for its shape (upsert; aligns the line's sheet_type).

get.summary: List customer orders (paged, filterable, sortable).

post.summary: Create an order header.

get.summary: Get one order header by id.

put.summary: Replace an order header. Supports If-Match.

get.summary: Get an order with its customer and line items (order-entry read model).

post.summary: Create an order header and its line items in one transaction.
Duplicate an order into a new order_abc_num — copies the header, every line item (order_item_num preserved), and each item's blank geometry; only the id and created timestamps are fresh.

get.summary: Customer coils earmarked to this order (ORDER_COIL), enriched with coil detail.

post.summary: Assign a customer coil to this order (ORDER_COIL). 409 if it's already on this order; 409 with code 'on-another-order' (+ otherOrderAbcNum) when the coil is on a different order — re-submit with confirm=true to proceed (legacy Continue? Yes/No).

get.summary: The order's-customer coils available to assign (status 1..9), each flagged if already on this order (assignedToThisOrder) or on a different order (otherOrderAbcNum — the dup-org warning).

delete.summary: Remove a coil from this order's ORDER_COIL assignment.

get.summary: List part-number master records (paged, sortable; filter by customerId/alloy).

post.summary: Create a part-number record (server-assigned id; requires customerId).

get.summary: Get one part-number record by id.

put.summary: Replace a part-number record (blocked with 409 if the part is applied to any order). Supports If-Match.

delete.summary: Delete a part and its blank geometry. 409 if the part is referenced by any order line (order_item.part_num_id).

get.summary: Get a part-master's blank geometry — the shape's dimensions (value + tolerances).

put.summary: Set a part-master's blank geometry for its shape (upsert; aligns the part's sheet_type; 409 if the part is applied to any order).

post.summary: Duplicate a part into a new part_num_id — copies every column + its blank geometry verbatim; the id is fresh.

get.summary: A part's routings (line/die/shape + SPM/efficiency standards + edge-trim/stacker flags), enriched with die + line names.

post.summary: Add a routing to a part (edit = delete + re-add). 404 if the part/line/die is unknown; 409 'duplicate' if the same routing already exists.

delete.summary: Remove a routing from a part (identified by routing sequence + line + die + sheet type).

get.summary: A job's production-folder summary (header + coil/skid/note counts).
The e-folder notes on a job (with author name).

post.summary: Add a note to a job's e-folder (author from the OIDC user or body userId).

get.summary: A coil's QA hold/release history (COIL_TRACK_QA audit, newest first).

post.summary: Place a coil on QA hold (coil_status → 11) and record the audit; 404 unknown, 409 terminal/already-on-hold.
Release a coil from QA hold (restores its pre-hold status, or ToStatus) and record the audit; 404 unknown, 409 if not on hold.

get.summary: WinSPC connector status: enabled + reachable (the read-only SPC quality DB).
WinSPC dimensional QC (readings + spec limits + in/out-of-spec) for an ABIS job number.
WinSPC dimensional QC for an ABIS coil number (matched on the WinSPC 'Coil #' tag).
The scrap/defect type catalog.
The product-type lookup.
Customers configured for recovery reporting.

put.summary: Configure (upsert) a customer for recovery reporting — customerName + scope flags (allProducts/autoOnly/commOnly, Y/N).

delete.summary: Remove a customer's recovery-reporting configuration.

get.summary: The scrap/defect types a customer tracks.

put.summary: Configure (upsert) a scrap/defect type a customer needs on the recovery report (abcOrMill + autoparts/nonAutoparts). 404 if the scrap type doesn't exist.

delete.summary: Remove a scrap/defect type from a customer's recovery-report needs.

get.summary: Resolve a barcode scanned on the handheld RF receiving gun (legacy coil_receiving_12.pl): strips the leading 'S' header, maps the fixed 000000 label to coil number 'NO BARCODE', returns any ABC numbers already minted for that customer coil plus the mill's advance notice. Outcome is Mint (none yet), AlreadyMinted (reprint OR mint another — legacy offers both) or Unreadable. Read-only: minting is a separate action.

post.summary: Mint an ABC number for a scanned inbound coil and print its label (legacy handheld). The printer is checked BEFORE anything is minted — 503 and no mint when it is unreachable, because an ABC number with no printed label leaves a coil untagged on the dock. 409 when the coil is not on any inbound receiving list. `replacedAbcNum` reports a previous number this overwrote (legacy's update is unscoped), so a superseded label isn't silent.

get.summary: List inbound receiving BOLs (paged, sortable; filter by customerId/status).

post.summary: Create an inbound receiving BOL (requires bol and customerId).

get.summary: Get one receiving BOL by id.

put.summary: Replace a receiving BOL. Supports If-Match.

get.summary: A receiving BOL with its coil line items (header + lines).
The coil line items on a receiving BOL.

post.summary: Add a coil line to a receiving BOL (coil_id assigned server-side).

delete.summary: Remove a coil line from a receiving BOL.

post.summary: Mint coil inventory for the BOL's lines (legacy w_coil_receiving save) — creates COIL rows (status 2/new, 11/on-hold if damaged) and links them. Idempotent; 400 if the BOL has no coils.

Generate + persist the 861 (Receiving Advice) X12 for a received BOL — built, integrated and stored, but NEVER transmitted (the VAN SFTP stays the legacy owner). 400 if the BOL has no coils, 422 if the customer isn't a configured 861 partner (Novelis/Aleris), 409 if already generated. View the payload at /edi/transactions/{ediFileId}/payload.

get.summary: A job's recovery-worksheet coils: reband / reject / special-attention / special-handling flags + product type.

put.summary: Set a coil's recovery-worksheet flags for a job (upsert). The coil must have been processed on the job.

delete.summary: Remove a coil from a job's recovery worksheet (deletes only the recovery overlay row; the processed coil is untouched).

get.summary: Daily recovery report for a job: each recovery coil's ship / scrap / rejected weights and yield. Weights come from the live f_get_coil_* functions on Oracle.
A job's recovery scrap broken down by defect type (Pareto order, heaviest first) with each defect's share of the total.
Per-line production summary (job count, avg yield, processed weight). Defaults to the last 365 days when unbounded.
Per-line efficiency: jobs, processed weight, avg yield, and downtime. Defaults to the last 365 days when unbounded.
Production rolled up by month (YYYY-MM): jobs touched + processed weight. Defaults to the last 365 days when unbounded.
Per-line, per-day processed weight from shift coils (SUM shift_coil.process_wt via SHIFT), optionally one line. Defaults to the last 365 days when unbounded.
Downtime minutes by cause code (SUM dt_instance_detail.duration/60 via dt_instance), optionally one line. Defaults to the last 365 days when unbounded.

Line uptime (legacy w_report_uptime): over WORKED shifts, uptime hours = (shift length − dt_total seconds)/3600, plus scheduled/downtime hours and uptime %. groupBy = line (default) | shift | day, optionally one line. Defaults to the last 365 days when unbounded.

Downtime rolled up along one dimension (legacy daily-prod downtime pivots): occurrences + minutes grouped by groupBy = cause (default) | job | part | line | shift | day | month | year, optionally one line. Defaults to the last 365 days when unbounded.
Downtime events (optionally one line), with duration minutes. Defaults to the last 365 days when unbounded.
Per-line on-time delivery (jobs finished on/before due date). Defaults to the last 365 days when unbounded.
Per-customer shipment roll-up (total / shipped / open + last ship date). Defaults to the last 365 days when unbounded.
Open (not-yet-sent) shipments with customer, carrier, and scheduled date.
Customer orders with PO / sales-order references (optionally one customer).
Per-customer finished sheet-skid counts + total net weight.
Coil inventory by alloy: count + total net/balance weight (optional status filter).
On-hold coils (coil_status = 3) with location, owner, and balance weight.
Finished sheet-skid inventory by status: count + total net weight.
Coils not referenced by any process_coil — orphan / unmatched inventory.
Mechanical test results by test type: count + average YTS/UTS/elongation. Defaults to the last 365 days when unbounded.
Scrap by type (code/defect) with skid count + total net weight.
Scrap by job: skid count + total net weight.
Production-order report (job traveler): per-job header + customer / order / order-line specs. Requires a scope filter (job, order, customer, or date).
A customer's finished sheet-skid inventory (via job → order), with optional skid status filter. Requires customerId.
Pending sales / quote list (customer, contact, latest win probability).

post.summary: Create a new sales quote (revision 1).

get.summary: A quote header (a specific revision of a quote).
The sales contact address book (optionally filtered to a customer).
Scheduled follow-ups / reminders for a quote.

post.summary: Log a follow-up / reminder against a quote.

get.summary: Win-probability review history for a quote.

post.summary: Record a win-probability review on a quote.

get.summary: List shop-floor scan events, newest first (paged, sortable; filter by abJobNum).

post.summary: Record a shop-floor scan event (append-only; requires abJobNum, scanStation, note).

get.summary: Get one scan event by id.
The application user roster.

post.summary: Create an application user (requires User Control; 409 on a duplicate login).

get.summary: One application user.

put.summary: Edit an application user's login/name/status (requires User Control; 409 on a colliding login).

delete.summary: Remove an application user and their grants/groups/credential (requires User Control).

get.summary: The groups a user belongs to.
A user's effective per-feature permissions (MAX of direct + group grants).
The calling user's effective permissions (resolved from the OIDC login / X-User-Login).
Whether the caller has at least the given privilege on a feature.
The security groups / roles.

post.summary: Create a security group (requires User Control).

get.summary: The protected feature catalog.

post.summary: Create a protected feature (requires User Control).
Set/reset a user's initial password (requires User Control; the user must change it on next sign-in).

put.summary: Set a user's privilege on a feature (0 = ReadOnly, 1 = Write; requires User Control).

delete.summary: Clear a user's direct grant on a feature (requires User Control).

put.summary: Set a group's privilege on a feature (0 = ReadOnly, 1 = Write; requires User Control).

delete.summary: Clear a group's grant on a feature (requires User Control).

post.summary: Add a user to a group (requires User Control).

delete.summary: Remove a user from a group (requires User Control).

get.summary: A group's per-feature grants (0 = ReadOnly, 1 = Write).
The users who belong to a group.

delete.summary: Remove a security group and its memberships/grants (requires User Control).
Remove a protected feature and its grants (requires User Control; the User Control feature itself is protected).

get.summary: List production shifts, newest first (paged, sortable; filter by lineNum).

post.summary: Create a production shift (one per line + schedule type + day).

get.summary: Get one shift by id.

put.summary: Replace a production shift. Supports If-Match.

get.summary: List shipments / packing lists (paged, sortable; filter by customerId).

post.summary: Create a shipment header (packing-list and bill-of-lading numbers server-assigned).

get.summary: Get one shipment by packing-list number.

put.summary: Replace a shipment header (packing-list and bill-of-lading numbers preserved). Supports If-Match.

patch.summary: Update a shipment's dispatch status (status, vehicle status, sent/actual times, notes). Supports If-Match.

post.summary: Record that an 856 or desadv was generated for a shipment — stamps edi_req/edi_triggered + the file id + date (docType = 856 default | desadv). Bookkeeping only; the modern stack never transmits EDI.

get.summary: A shipment's status-change audit trail (legacy SHIPMENT_TRACK) — before/after shipment + vehicle status (and customer/ship-to) with who/when, newest first.

Everything a printed bill of lading needs (legacy rpabco/u_default_billoflading): parties, the three sections (sheet skids / accumulated scrap return / rejected coil return) with counts and weights, the per-job PO/part blocks, the shipment total, and the whole BOL's multi-stop totals. Read-only. `empty` = nothing to ship (legacy refuses to print); `detailsPrintable` = false past 3 jobs, which the legacy form has no room for.

post.summary: Close out a shipment / BOL — mark it shipped and stamp the sent + actual dates.

get.summary: List the line items on a packing list (shipment) — SHEET (finished-sheet skids, enriched with weight/pieces/part/PO/coil — the same content the 856 (ASN) reports), SCRAP (scrap skids), and REJECT_COIL (rejected coils), each tagged with its itemType.

post.summary: Add a line item to a packing list — itemType SHEET (finished sheet) / SCRAP (scrap) with refNum = the skid number, or REJECT_COIL with refNum = the coil abc number. The item id + packaging ticket are server-assigned. 400 bad type; 404 if the shipment or skid/coil is missing; 409 if it's already on this list. Config/data only — nothing transmits.

delete.summary: Remove a line item (by itemType SHEET/SCRAP + its id) from a packing list.

get.summary: List part sketches/drawings (paged, sortable; filter by status). Excludes the binary image.

post.summary: Create a sketch header (server-assigned id; requires sketchName; image not written via API).

get.summary: Get one sketch header by id (no image).

put.summary: Replace a sketch header (image left untouched). Supports If-Match.

get.summary: The sketch's drawing (BMP). 404 when the sketch does not exist or has no image.
List finished sheet skids (paged, sortable).

post.summary: Create a finished sheet skid (its job must belong to an order).

get.summary: Get one sheet skid by id.

delete.summary: Delete a sheet skid (and its detail + dimension-check rows), guarded: 409 if it's on a shipment; 404 if unknown; 204 on delete.

patch.summary: Correct a sheet skid's weights/pieces/date/status (partial; totals disagreeing with its items are returned as warnings, never corrected).

get.summary: List scrap skids (paged, sortable).

post.summary: Create a scrap skid.

get.summary: Get one scrap skid by id.

delete.summary: Delete a scrap skid, guarded: 409 if it's on a shipment; 404 if unknown; 204 on delete.

post.summary: Return (un-scrap) a scrap skid — restores its scrapped sheet-skid/production rows to the live tables and removes the scrap records (legacy F_CONVERT_BACK_TO_SHEET). 404 if the scrap skid is unknown.

Convert a sheet skid to scrap (legacy F_CONVERT_TO_SCRAP) — mints a scrap skid, moves the skid + its production items to the scraped_* mirror tables, credits each item as a return_scrap_item, and removes the live sheet-skid rows. 404 if the sheet skid is unknown. Reversible via /scrap-skids/{n}/return.

get.summary: List in-process partial skids (paged, sortable).
A line's stacker board: jobs on the line with coil/skid counts (read-only monitor).
The line/stacker error log (error_evt ⋈ error_type), newest first.

post.summary: Log a line/stacker error event.

get.summary: List posted mechanical test results (paged, filterable, sortable).

post.summary: Record a posted mechanical test result (pst_test_result) for a coil — YTS/UTS/elongation/n/r + thickness/width at a sample position. coilAbcNum + position are required; created_date is stamped server-side. 404 if the coil is missing. This is the write that lets the read-only test-results list populate.

get.summary: List in-progress (working-set) mechanical test results.
List truck appointments (paged; filter by direction / status / scheduled-date range).

post.summary: Schedule a truck appointment.

get.summary: Get one truck appointment.

put.summary: Edit a truck appointment.

get.summary: Look up truck appointments by BOL / ref number or appointment id (driver kiosk).

post.summary: Gate/kiosk check-in — stamp arrival + set status 'Parked out back'; an optional body captures the driver name/phone (kiosk sign-in).
Gate check-out — stamp departure + set status Signed-out; an outbound truck also closes its linked BOL. 409 if it never checked in.

patch.summary: Set a truck's location status (0 Pending, 1 Late, 2 Parked, 3–5 Sent to Bldg 1–3, 6 Signed out, 9 Cancelled).

post.summary: Create a warehoused skid (legacy warehouse module w_wh_business): resolves or MINTS the status-20 warehouse coil for the customer's (coil number, lot) — an empty shell with zero weight — then writes the sheet_skid, its production item and the link, and reads back the package number. Weight/piece mismatches come back as `warnings`, not refusals, matching legacy's "save it anyway?" prompt. 409 when the job has no order, or when the customer requires a cert label / cash date and no regular coil exists to back one.

put.summary: Modify a warehoused skid (legacy warehouse module action 4): weights, pieces, date, status and warehouse provenance. Changing the customer coil number or lot RE-POINTS the skid at a different status-20 shell — minting one if needed — and collects the PREVIOUS shell when the move leaves nothing on it. Weight mismatches come back as `warnings`, not refusals.

delete.summary: Delete a warehoused skid: its sheet_skid_detail links, its production items and the skid, then GARBAGE-COLLECT the status-20 warehouse coil when nothing else references it (legacy warehouse module action 5) — the shell exists only while something hangs off it. `coilKeptReason` says why the coil survived. A coil that is NOT a status-20 shell is never collected, so a real coil can't be destroyed by a warehouse delete.

post.summary: Add one production item to an existing warehoused skid (legacy warehouse module action 2). The item carries its OWN customer coil number + lot, so a skid can hold material from several coils — that pair resolves or MINTS its status-20 shell, with the same cert/cash-date refusal as the create path. Optionally restates the skid header (legacy re-weighs on add); a total that disagrees with the sum of the items comes back in `warnings`, never corrected.

delete.summary: Remove one production item from a warehoused skid (legacy warehouse module action 3), collecting its status-20 shell when nothing else references it. The SKID is left standing even when its last item goes — an empty skid is re-stockable, and cascading it away would destroy a pallet's record over a single corrected line. A coil that is not a status-20 shell is never collected.

patch.summary: Warehouse update of a sheet skid (location / ticket / status; 409 if the skid has shipped).

ApiKey.description: API key sent in the X-Api-Key header.
ApiKey.name: X-Api-Key

Bearer.description: JWT bearer token from your OIDC provider (when Auth:Jwt is configured).
